name: Fluently
long_description:
Imagine a human-like English tutor, but 20x cheaper and available 24/7 - that's Fluently!

Fluently made for people who already know the basics of English but want to feel truly confident in real conversations: whether that’s in an interview, a business meeting, or chatting with friends.

Most English learning apps are built for beginners and don’t help you improve speaking skills.

With Fluently, you get:
- Unlimited real-world speaking practice
- Personalized learning plan
- Free English level assessment and progress tracking
- Real progress in English speaking skills

We’re non-native founders who know the stress of speaking English in important moments. With deep AI expertise, we built Fluently to solve it.
one_liner: Speaking coach for non-native English professionals

During his university years, Yurii interned at Google, Nvidia, Lyft, and Amazon, where he did ML research. Later, he founded and grew a deep tech startup from 2 to 50 people. The startup developed state-of-the-art face and voice swap technologies that work on mobile devices in real-time.

launches.title: 💁‍♀️ Fluently: Your Personal AI English Tutor
launches.tagline: Imagine a human-like English tutor, available 24/7 and 20x cheaper
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** [Fluently](https://getfluently.app/) is your personal AI English tutor — 20x cheaper than a human tutor and available 24/7. Built for people who already know the basics but want to speak fluently.

### **Problem — Getting fluent in English is hard**

* **Fluency only comes from regular speaking practice:** The only way to truly improve is to speak consistently and iterate on your mistakes. There's no shortcut.
* **Most language apps aren't built for speaking:** They're essentially games for beginners - they won't give you the real-time speaking practice you'd get from actually talking to someone.
* **Nobody gives you the honest feedback you need:** Most non-natives feel anxious about their mistakes but never actually hear about them - colleagues stay polite, and even tutors rarely provide the detailed, personalized feedback that would help you truly improve.

### **Solution — Get actionable feedback on every call**

* **Learn on the go:** Fluently is always available for a real-time conversation - just open the app and start speaking. No scheduling, no waiting.
* **Personalized insights:** Fluently analyzes your real speech and pinpoints exactly where you need to improve — whether it's pronunciation, fluency, or vocabulary.
* **Actionable feedback:** Practice pronunciation, improve fluency, and grow your active vocabulary to boost your English skills.

### **Who is this for?**

* **Non-native speakers** who want to finally speak English fluently and confidently - not just "know" the language, but actually use it in real conversations without hesitation or anxiety.
* **International companies** who understand that communication efficiency directly impacts business results. Companies already invest in language training for their employees - Fluently makes that investment practical and measurable, helping teams communicate more clearly with clients, partners, and each other.

### **Our ask**

* 🎓 **Intros to multinational companies** that invest resources in their employees' growth, **especially in English learning**. Please, email [yrebryk@getfluently.app](mailto:yrebryk@getfluently.app).
* **👉 Sign up [here](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdhnAZ-BAuzcKhaB5QFvtLgYHCt6v1Q-r1hKuBMwMkzs8ykjQ/viewform) to get access.** We’re onboarding our users one by one. DM me on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/yrebryk/) to get moved to the front of the waitlist.
